article.body:
Mesh-based neural method is for composite simulation, not factory output

An arXiv paper titled “A mesh-based neural energy method for the simulation of heterogeneous composites” describes a computational method for simulating heterogeneous composites. The available record identifies no factory, production line or equipment installation. It specifies no production capacity, demonstrated throughput or physical operating constraint, and names no customers or suppliers. No change to composite manufacturing output or supply flows is established.
